hint.frontierhunts.sled.ride: Use: ride · Sneak + Use: pick it up
item.frontierhunts.sled.desc1: Place it on snow, sit on it and point it downhill: it picks up speed the whole way down and flies off the crests.
item.frontierhunts.sled.desc2: Left/right to carve, back to brake, forward to push off. Sneak + Use to pick it up.
